t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Choose one set of gnomes to keep selecting either the cold colour or warm colours to lead to a specific basket and use the x1 multiplier to see if the other basket is giving a higher number of mushrooms.

vb_textbox.text: The warm colours: red, brown, orange and pink, purple gnomes correspond to a red basket and the cold colours: blue, yellow, green gnomes correspond to a yellow basket. Begin selecting one set of gnomes which correspond to either the red or yellow basket. If that basket gives you a low amount of mushrooms (3 or under) consider switching to the other basket on a X1 multiplier and mentally note if the number of mushrooms in that basket is high than the other or not.
